evals.prompt: Explain how the compliance engineer deconstructs an input skill into a testable compliance verification matrix.
asserts: Identifies anti-patterns table and architectural directives as rule sources
Breaks down high-level requirements into atomic selectors and constraints
Generates rule matrix with status tracking (PASS/FAIL)

evals.prompt: Describe the zero-stopping continuous enforcement loop protocol of the compliance skill.
asserts: Outlines cycle: inspect -> check rule -> flag deviation -> patch -> re-verify
Specifies that audit does not terminate until 100% compliance is reached

evals.prompt: How does the compliance engineer adapt when executing in Google Antigravity versus Claude Code or Cursor?
asserts: In Antigravity: uses /compliance-swarm to fan out worker agents across modules
In Claude Code / Cursor: runs deterministic sequential verification loop
Aggregates all findings into central compliance-report.md

evals.prompt: What are the required sections and format of the compliance audit dossier?
asserts: Includes overall compliance score percentage and rule-by-rule matrix table
Includes side-by-side git diffs for non-compliant code lines
